You might say

I want customers to book inside WeChat without installing another app.

A lightweight app that runs inside a host app such as WeChat·A shop can share a booking mini program in a chat, letting customers choose a time inside WeChat. A browser booking page may look the same; its runtime and available capabilities differ.

WeChat chatTeaching example

Let’s try pottery this weekend. Pick a time in this booking mini program.

Mini programGreen Studio · Book a workshopChoose a time and book

This card opens a mini program. QR codes and chat cards can also open websites, so the entry shape alone does not determine the runtime.

What does the host app provide?

An environment for the app: The host loads the mini program code and provides navigation, components, and supported device capabilities.

Its own development rules: A native WeChat mini program uses WXML for structure, WXSS for styles, and JavaScript for behavior. Other platforms have their own conventions.

Does opening the page mean a booking was saved?

Opening the page does not prove a booking was saved. Saving records still needs a backend or cloud service, and platform permissions and release requirements must be checked separately.
